notes.title: The Game will be sooun released
notes.notes:
I will release this game soon [before 12 CET if there aren't any problems]. I fixed some errors that I found and changed something that I found not well made. 

IF you encounter bugs, or do you want something to be changed please give me a Feedback feedback so I can improve, add or change things in this game or in future games that I'm planning to make. I hope you will Like this project of mine and have fun

I will do better games in future and for now I'm working on a second game and I think I will finish it in less than a year, because I don't want to give you some rushed project only too make money and I want to deliver some good stuff so you can have fun or enjoy playing, but being only one working on these projects will take some time (I'm not sure so for this one check my social accounts for work and more).
